## Interfaces

Contract optional fields `answer` / `signed_note` / `resolution_note`; `NeedsYouItem.revision`; `dismiss.py` approve/reject/sign/accept (displayed `--expected-revision`, never `@current`; reject=`create` finding; sign/reject pre-`get` guard); `approval.py` evidence + confirm helpers; `app.py` list-`d`→detail, detail `a`/`x`/`s`/`d`→`NeedsConfirmModal`; README keys; approval pilots; active `dashboard-human-gate-writes` covers Needs-you + backlog promote/dismiss (`applies_to` includes `backlog.py`)

## Assumptions

Brief + phase diff + active store constraint (prior exclusive-wording finding superseded); `correct` has no `--expected-revision` (pre-`get` as designed); backlog path unchanged (`@current`) and explicitly in-policy

## Invariants

No Needs-you write without detail+confirm — held; stale never silently `@current` — held; Reject never answers continuity-question — held; allowed write set matches active constraint (Needs-you gates + backlog promote/dismiss) — held

## Conflicts

none (prior exclusive human-gate vs backlog conflict resolved by superseding constraint statement)
